import { useMessage } from '@src/utils/useMessage';
import { createBackendRequestContext } from '@src/api/bot/context';
/**
 * 信誉分查询指令
 * 指令：#信誉分 / #我的信誉
 */
import App from '@src/response-apps/market/credibility/app';
import { selects } from '@src/response/config';
import { FormatGui } from '@src/utils/messageHelper';
import { Format, onResponse } from 'alemonjs';

export default onResponse(selects, async e => {
  const [message] = useMessage();
  const bid = e?.UserId;
  const uid = e.uid as number;
  const isPrivate = e.isPrivate ?? false;

  const result = await App({ bid, uid, request: createBackendRequestContext(e) });
  const md = Format.createMarkdown();

  if (result.code !== 'OK') {
    md.addText('查询信誉分失败，请稍后再试。');

    void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '', content: md }));

    return;
  }

  const info = result.data;

  md.addText('【交易信誉】');
  md.addNewline();
  md.addText(`综合信誉分：${info.totalScore} / ${info.maxScore}`);
  md.addNewline();
  md.addText(info.progressBar);
  md.addNewline();
  md.addNewline();

  md.addText('【分数明细】');
  md.addNewline();
  md.addBlockquote(
    Format.createMarkdown()
      .addText(`基础分：${info.baseScore}`)
      .addNewline()
      .addText(`VIP加成：+${info.vipBonus}`)
      .addNewline()
      .addText(`月卡加成：+${info.monthCardBonus}`)
      .addNewline()
      .addText(`活跃分：+${info.activityScore}`)
  );

  md.addText('【状态】');
  md.addNewline();

  md.addBlockquote(Format.createMarkdown().addText(info.statusText));

  md.addNewline();
  md.addBlockquote(Format.createMarkdown().addText(`每日免费撤单：${info.dailyFreeCancelLimit} 次`));

  void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '交易信誉', content: md }));
});
